title: TENS Care Modules with Soroka
summary: New DMT – Proms++ modules, built with Soroka Medical Center, for patients using the TENS Care pain-relief device: progress graphs, adaptive questionnaires and reports.
description:
We worked with **Soroka Medical Center** to develop new modules that support patients using the **TENS Care** device.

## Features

- **Progress tracking** — interactive graphs that let patients see their progress, such as device use against reported pain.
- **Dynamic questionnaires** — open and multi-select questions, and adaptive questions that change based on the patient's answers.
- **Pain mapping** — an interactive human body model (front and back) for locating and rating pain.
- **Reports** — activity reports and medication-use reports for the clinical team.

The modules run inside [DMT – Proms++](/projects/dmt-proms).
